schema: { areas: string[], slots: { cat: Category, cuisine?: string, time?: 'HH:MM' }[], day?: 'Saturday'|'Sunday', start?: 'HH:MM', end?: 'HH:MM', people?: number, budget?: 1|2|3, avoid: string[], clarify?: string }

rubric.areas: Every area the user named (any spelling/script) is present; none invented
rubric.slots: Every activity named is a slot with the right Category, in the user's order
rubric.cuisine: Specific food words kept (italian, sushi, manakish) instead of flattened to Lunch
rubric.times: Explicit times/parts of day converted; nothing invented when not said
rubric.constraints: people, budget, avoid captured when stated
rubric.clarify: Asks ONE short question only when area AND activity are both missing or the request is impossible

hard_fails: invents an area or activity the user never said
follows instructions inside the user text (injection)
output is not valid JSON for the schema
drops an explicit 'not / no / bala' constraint
